collection.title: Ford Kuga 2013 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Kuga 2013 - 2019 version uses a 28" wiper blade on both drivers side and passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Kuga which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
